issues: Nit: patch_class runs as a nested function and the ERR trap isn't inherited without `set -E`; a set -e failure inside it would exit without calling the revert helper. Recovery is safe (grub.cfg not yet replaced; rerun prints STOP-tar-exists). Add `set -E` to close it.
Nit: patch_class has no existence check; if 10_linux_zfs were ever missing, the grep -c result would be empty and the integer test would error. Live read shows it exists.
Nit: rsyslog disk-assisted queue (queue.filename + saveOnShutdown) has no queue.maxDiskSpace, so a long collector outage could grow /var/spool/rsyslog without limit. Suggest queue.maxDiskSpace="1g".
Nit: on rsyslogd -N1 failure the script removes the new drop-in but does not restore /root/batch10-60-johnny-remote.conf.bak if one existed.
Nit: /root/batch10-grub.cfg.new is left behind after success. It holds only the pbkdf2 hash, never the password.
Nit: `systemctl reload rsyslog` in the revert helper runs under set -e, so a failed reload would skip rm of the tar. Make it non-fatal like the journald line.
